messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Monitoring alert: na-east SSE disconnect rate spike (stream_disconnect_rate +270% over baseline). 5xx gateway responses up ~18%. Affected namespaces: prod-*, traffic window starting ~1:04 UTC.

alex: ack. I'm taking this. seeing a correlated p95 token latency jump and a bunch of RST_STREAM from the LB to envoys. Initial theory: keepalive/idle time mismatch causing upstream resets while client attempts resume.

maya: pulling envoy/nginx logs now. quick snippet:
```
2026-03-15T01:05:12Z envoy outbound: stream id=132 RST_STREAM code=2 upstream:10.10.45.23:8080 "stream reset by peer"
2026-03-15T01:05:13Z nginx upstream: 502 while reading response header from upstream, client: 172.18.5.6, server: api.redwood-na-east
2026-03-15T01:05:14Z lb: connection close: keepalive timeout 15s (client retry window ~8-12s)
```

matt: customers on support queue are reporting partial SSE payloads (missing final "DONE" delimiter) and some say they were charged twice for the same request.

danielle: that billing dupes bit makes sense if clients reconnect and server replays tokens when resume=true. some clients don't send unique session ids so backend can't dedupe. we should tell support to ask for x-stream-session-id or recommend idempotency tokens.

alex: immediate mitigation proposal:
- increase envoy/max-concurrent-streams and bump keepalive timeout to 45s in na-east env (reduces upstream RSTs).
- temporarily enable cross-region failover to na-west for new streamed sessions (read-only routing policy change).
- add a short-lived proxy that assembles full response before streaming for extremely flaky clients (best-effort).
- recommend customers include header `x-stream-session-id` to dedupe on reconnect.

maya: I can patch the envoy config now. runbook command:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-config -p '{"data":{"http1_max_header_size":"8192","keepalive_timeout":"45s","max_concurrent_streams":"1000"}}'
# then rollout restart for ingress pods
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/envoy-ingress
```

alex: doing the route flip to na-west for new streams (non-destructive). I'll update the routing policy:
```
# temporary route rule
POST /internal/route/update { "region": "na-west", "selector": "streaming=true AND customer_tier!=enterprise", "mode": "failover" }
```

support-bot: repro steps for support to collect:
1) curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "x-stream-session-id: <uuid>" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream?model=redwood-large&resume=true"
2) if you see partial output (no DONE event) capture raw response and include `Connection` and `Keep-Alive` headers.
3) provide the token_age (seconds since token issued) if possible — we suspect token refresh within the 60s window triggers resume race.

danielle: for billing investigators: mark affected invoices and set a claim flag 'sse-resume-replay' so finance can auto-refund/outbound credit where we detect replay without unique session id. we'll need logs showing request id + session id or lack thereof.

matt: customer-facing note draft (short):
"We're investigating an intermittent issue affecting streaming responses in na-east. Some streams may disconnect early or resume with duplicate data. We're routing new streams to a healthy region and deploying fixes. If you use streaming, please add an `x-stream-session-id` header to help dedup. We'll update within 30 minutes."

alex: status page update pushed to status.redwood.ai/incidents/1984001234 (draft). severity: SEV2. owners: alex (primary), maya (secondary).

maya: envoy config patched and ingress pods restarting (rolling). watching metrics: errors falling but still higher than baseline.

ops-bot: new metric: stream_disconnect_rate down to +80% now (from +270%). gateway 5xx down to +6%.

alex: follow-ups:
- engineering to add server-side dedupe by x-stream-session-id for replayed resumes (short term).
- infra to investigate token refresh window — possible race when refresh occurs during streaming handshake (auth service and gateway TTL mismatch).
- product to notify some high-touch enterprise customers (we're not flipping their region).

danielle: long-term: add resume-token semantics that are idempotent (server returns resume-token that encodes last-ack token position so replay won't double-bill). ticket: ENG-STREAM-412.

support-bot: guidance for support replies to customers:
- tell customers to add `x-stream-session-id: <uuid>` now.
- if they still see partial output, advise switching to polling for critical flows until we complete patching (how-to link to polling guide).

matt: I've flagged three customers in priority queue to receive proactive outreach.

alex: closing loop — will leave thread open while we watch for 2 hours. if any new reports post-mitigation, paste raw curl output and headers here. thanks all. :thumbsup:
